description: This file defines an enumeration 'SavingsAccountTransactionType' representing various transaction types for a savings account in the Fineract project, including methods for classification and retrieval.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionType
classes.description: Enumeration of different transaction types for savings accounts, with utility methods for classification and filtering.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the transaction type's ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the transaction type's value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: getEntryType
methods.description: Returns the associated TransactionEntryType, if any.

methods.name: isCreditEntryType
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type has a credit entry type.

methods.name: isDebitEntryType
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type has a debit entry type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction type from its integer value, defaults to INVALID if not found.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is valid (not INVALID).

methods.name: isDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a deposit.

methods.name: isWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a withdrawal.

methods.name: isInterestPosting
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is interest posting.

methods.name: isOverDraftInterestPosting
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is overdraft interest.

methods.name: isWithHoldTax
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is withholding tax.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a withdrawal fee.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is an annual fee.

methods.name: isPayCharge
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a pay charge.

methods.name: isChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a charge (pay charge, withdrawal fee, or annual fee).

methods.name: isWaiveCharge
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is to waive charges.

methods.name: isTransferInitiation
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is transfer initiation.

methods.name: isTransferApproval
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is transfer approval.

methods.name: isTransferRejection
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is transfer rejection.

methods.name: isTransferWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is transfer withdrawal.

methods.name: isWrittenoff
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is written off.

methods.name: isDividendPayout
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is dividend payout.

methods.name: isIncomeFromInterest
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is income from interest (overdraft interest).

methods.name: isEscheat
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is escheat.

methods.name: isAmountOnHold
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is amount on hold.

methods.name: isAmountRelease
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is amount release.

methods.name: isAccrual
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is accrual.

methods.name: isCredit
methods.description: Determines if the transaction type is a credit, excluding amount release.

methods.name: isDebit
methods.description: Determines if the transaction type is a debit, excluding amount on hold and escheat.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Returns a list of transaction types filtered by a predicate.
